note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom RD), ~17 mi west of Wisdom on Hwy 43, on flat ground in dense lodgepole pine at ~6,300 ft. May Creek runs along the west edge. Big Hole National Battlefield nearby. --Claude
